description: This file is a C header file defining function prototypes and forward declarations related to preload index operations within a version control system, likely Git. It declares functions for preloading an index and reading a repository index with preload optimizations.

methods.name: preload_index
methods.description: Preloads the index given the index state, pathspec, and refresh flags.

methods.name: repo_read_index_preload
methods.description: Reads the repository index with preload, given the repository, pathspec, and refresh flags.
